title: Assignment targets must be patterns
subtitle: Calls with arguments are not binding patterns.

title: Typed lets bind a name
subtitle: Destructure separately; a typed let cannot bind a constructor pattern.

title: Case patterns are not lambdas
subtitle: Recursive constructor / literal / list / tuple patterns remain supported.

title: Law templates must come first
subtitle: A template clause cannot follow an ordinary quantified clause.
source:
import Base

law boundary:
  for x: U32
  for ~f: U32 -> U32
  U32

def after() -> U32:
  42
repair:
import Base

law boundary:
  for ~f: U32 -> U32
  for x: U32
  U32

def after() -> U32:
  42
